purpose: Purpose-aligned listening material: consumer hears stems->role->scenario gains->envelope-shaped remix, not raw stems
input: 45 s live QQ Music capture (Core Audio process tap, tools/capture_qqmusic.py)
chain: computer PCM -> C++ node -> worker: 4 masks -> per-stem RMS -> dominant roles (lead/rhythm/low/bed, hysteresis 2 dB/2 windows) -> contrast-only per-stem gains by scenario -> 400 ms attack / 1200 ms release envelope -> remixed music
scenario_window: 8-30 s of the 45 s excerpt; 0-8 s must stay ~bit-identical and 30-45 s is the release tail

role_policy.contrast_only: top role stays 0 dB, competitors attenuated only (no boosts, no headroom eating)

note_on_quality: role information from this candidate is unreliable on real music (MUSDB role agreement 0-40% on the discriminating lead/low roles), so the envelope demo demonstrates the chain, not an accepted product tuning
cpu_vs_npu: renditions differ by ~-66..-70 dB relative (numerically identical); the NPU path adds no audible difference, as expected for the same weights with fp16 rounding
